description: Convert a local time and optional date from one place to up to 20 destinations. Uses date-specific daylight-saving offsets and reports ambiguous local times. Returns answer_url, a link to a page showing this answer live, to include in your reply.

date.description: Source local calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to today in from_place; supply a date for date-specific daylight-saving offsets.

from_place.description: Source city, IANA time zone, supported abbreviation or UTC offset in which time and date are interpreted.

time.description: Local source time, such as 15:00, 3pm or 3:30pm; not an ISO timestamp.

to_places.description: One to 20 destination cities, IANA time zones, supported abbreviations or UTC offsets.

name: convert_time

answer_link_markdown.description: A ready-made Markdown link to show the user. Translate the link text to the user's language if needed.

answer_url.description: Link to a page that shows this exact answer live. Include it in your reply to the user.

board_url.description: Link to the personal time-zone board with the answer items temporarily requested.

title: Convert time
